newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila exempts thrift banks from property loan cap.
newsitem.headline: Manila exempts thrift banks from property loan cap.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank said on Monday it had agreed to temporarily exclude thrift and savings banks from its earlier order setting a 20 percent limit on the exposure of banks to the real estate sector.

Thrift and savings banks were also exempted from the drop in loans to 60 percent of a property's appraised value from the previous 70 percent, Central Bank deputy governor Alberto Reyes told reporters.

Reyes said the Central Bank plans to work out a new set of guidelines on the amount that can be lent for real estate by thrift and savings banks, which derive most of their income from consumer loans.
The Central Bank imposed the limits last month after Philippine share prices were hit by speculation of a property price crash.
